get_wages.sql: SELECT SUM(wl.cr_amount) as total FROM wages_ledger wl JOIN employees e ON wl.employee_id = e.id WHERE 1=1

list_employees.sql: SELECT e.full_name, e.designation, o.OfficeName FROM employees e JOIN office o ON e.officeid = o.Officeid WHERE 1=1

list_machinery.sql: SELECT name as machine_name, make, status FROM turf_machines WHERE 1=1

list_gc_machinery.sql: SELECT machinery_name, machinery_id_no, machinery_type, status FROM gc_machinery WHERE 1=1

list_inventory.sql: SELECT item_name, unit_of_measurement, current_balance FROM gc_view_main_stock_balance WHERE 1=1

list_activity_logs.sql: SELECT timestamp, user_name, action, details FROM activity_log ORDER BY timestamp DESC

list_aa_es.sql: SELECT sub_head, type, status, CASE WHEN type = 'Manpower' THEN (SELECT SUM((item->>'qty')::numeric * (item->>'rate')::numeric * (boq->>'Period')::numeric) FROM jsonb_array_elements(boq->'Items') AS item) WHEN type = 'Market' THEN (SELECT SUM((item->>'qty')::numeric * (item->>'rate')::numeric * (1 + RTRIM(item->>'gst', '%')::numeric / 100)) FROM jsonb_array_elements(boq) AS item) END AS aa_es_amount FROM aa_es WHERE 1=1

list_aaes.sql: SELECT sub_head, type, status, CASE WHEN type = 'Manpower' THEN (SELECT SUM((item->>'qty')::numeric * (item->>'rate')::numeric * (boq->>'Period')::numeric) FROM jsonb_array_elements(boq->'Items') AS item) WHEN type = 'Market' THEN (SELECT SUM((item->>'qty')::numeric * (item->>'rate')::numeric * (1 + RTRIM(item->>'gst', '%')::numeric / 100)) FROM jsonb_array_elements(boq) AS item) END AS aa_es_amount FROM aa_es WHERE 1=1

list_consumables.sql: SELECT item_name, unit_of_measurement, current_balance FROM gc_view_main_stock_balance WHERE 1=1

list_turf_consumption_log.sql: SELECT tcl.log_date, tm.name as machine_name, tcl.recorded_by as operator, tcl.fuel_consumed_qty, tcl.running_hours FROM turf_consumption_log tcl JOIN turf_machines tm ON tcl.machine_id = tm.id WHERE 1=1

report_monthly_consumption.sql: SELECT m.name as machine_name, SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) as total_fuel_consumed FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id WHERE 1=1

report_consumption_trend.sql: SELECT to_char(c.log_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) as total_consumed FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id JOIN turf_inventory_items i ON m.fuel_item_id = i.id WHERE 1=1
report_consumption_trend.group_by: GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

list_with_ordering.sql: SELECT tcl.log_date, tm.name as machine_name, tcl.recorded_by as operator, tcl.fuel_consumed_qty, tcl.running_hours FROM turf_consumption_log tcl JOIN turf_machines tm ON tcl.machine_id = tm.id WHERE 1=1

report_historical_balance.sql: SELECT i.description, i.ac_unit, (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.transaction_type = 'RECEIPT' THEN l.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.transaction_type = 'ISSUE' THEN l.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.fuel_consumed_qty) FROM turf_consumption_log c JOIN turf_machines m ON c.machine_id = m.id WHERE m.fuel_item_id = i.id AND c.log_date <= :date_param), 0)) as balance_on_date FROM turf_inventory_items i LEFT JOIN turf_inventory_ledger l ON i.id = l.item_id AND l.transaction_date <= :date_param
